schema_gaps.gap: The LiteratureAtom model is primary-literature-oriented and has no dedicated atom kind for a narrative review's secondary report of a cited study result.
schema_gaps.handling: Numeric/clinical-study summaries are encoded as atom_kind=other with tag secondary_reported_result, anchored to the review, rather than represented as if this review enrolled participants.

source_excerpt_match_audit.method: Exact snippet match to normalized current PDF text layer after whitespace/dehyphenation normalization; figure/page-only locators allowed where the PDF text layer is duplicated/garbled.

anchor_audit.note: All atoms satisfy literature.py SourceAnchor locator requirements; one atom intentionally uses a page-only locator because the PDF text layer is duplicated/garbled at that location.
